entry.title: I vantaggi dei data center nello spazio

link.title: I vantaggi dei data center nello spazio

entry.content:
I recently published an article on Space Economy on the italian news outlet Airpress. The article explains how the rapid growth of AI is pushing terrestrial data centers to their physical and energy limits, prompting companies to explore building data centers in space. In orbit, solar power is continuous, cooling is naturally provided by the vacuum, and falling launch costs could make this approach economically viable once prices drop below $200 per kilogram. Google, the startup Starcloud, and Chinese institutions are already developing early systems, including satellites equipped with TPU and GPU hardware. If current trends continue, future cloud infrastructure may move off-planet, with orbital data centers offering cheaper energy, passive cooling, and large-scale computing capacity.

Download the article [PDF]

entry.title: AI in Finance Workshop
entry.content:
Reflections on the AI in Finance Workshop at ECAI 2025, Bologna

On October 26, 2025, I had the pleasure of co-organizing the AI in Finance Workshop at this year’s European Conference on Artificial Intelligence (ECAI) in Bologna. The event exceeded all expectations: more than 80 participants joined us for a full day of discussions, presentations, and exchanges at the intersection of artificial intelligence and financial innovation.

I had the opportunity to moderate a panel dedicated to the role of AI in the financial industry, featuring speakers from Intesa Sanpaolo, Banco d’Italia, and Simitain. Their perspectives on regulation, model adoption, and real-world deployment made the session one of the highlights of the workshop.

I also presented our recent work on optimal execution using the Q-Reactive model, discussing how reinforcement learning can improve execution strategies in modern electronic markets.

You can find the full program and event details here:
https://sites.google.com/view/ECAI25-ai-fin

The workshop generated great energy, insightful conversations, and a strong sense of community. Thank you to everyone who joined and contributed — looking forward to next steps and future collaborations!

Download the slides [PDF].

Here you can find the arxiv paper: Reinforcement Learning in Queue-Reactive Models: Application to Optimal Execution.

entry.title: Quant Finance
entry.content:
I held a course at the HEC Paris FinTech Summer School entitled Quant Finance. This was part of the “FinTech: The Future of Finance” program (June 30 - July 11, 2025), where I taught on July 4th, 2025. The course covered comprehensive topics across four main areas:

Financial Markets

  • Market Making
  • Execution
  • Asset Managers and Hedge Funds
  • Prop Traders
  • Quants

Financial Engineering

  • Stochastic processes
  • Option pricing
  • MC simulations
  • Execution algorithms

Quant Toolkit

  • Supervised Learning
  • Unsupervised Learning
  • Reinforcement Learning
  • Deep Learning
  • Generative AI

Quant Research

  • Classical systematic strategies
  • Learning an trading strategy with RL
  • Intraday trading with ML
  • Cross sectional momentum with LLMs

entry.title: Optimal Execution via Reinforcement Learning
entry.content:
I presented at the International Fintech Research Conference on January 31, 2025, discussing Optimal Execution via Reinforcement Learning in Agent-Based Simulations.

My presentation focused on optimal execution strategies using reinforcement learning. I introduced the problem definition and its formulation as a Markov Decision Process (MDP), highlighting key aspects such as execution trajectories, market impact, and transaction cost minimization. I then delved into reinforcement learning algorithms, discussing Q-learning and Deep Q-Networks (DQN). Additionally, I explored the role of limit order book (LOB) simulations, comparing various execution policies against traditional approaches like TWAP and passive algorithms. Finally, I presented experimental results showcasing how reinforcement learning can minimize market impact while optimizing execution efficiency.

Download the slides [PDF].

Here you can find the arxiv paper: Optimal Execution via Reinforcement Learning in Agent Based Simulations.

entry.title: Quantitative Trading with Machine Learning
entry.content:
I presented at the Workshop on AI in Finance at ECAI 2024 in Santiago de Compostela, Spain on October 19, 2024. This workshop brought together researchers and practitioners from both industry and academia to discuss recent advancements in AI applications for financial services.

My presentation focused on quantitative trading with machine learning. I covered a range of topics, starting with classical strategies such as momentum, mean reversion, and seasonality. Then, I delved into more advanced techniques, exploring the application of reinforcement learning in trading. Finally, I discussed higher frequency trading strategies and their implementation with futures contracts.

You can find more details about the workshop and its program on the official website.

entry.title: I vantaggi di fare rifornimento sulla luna

link.title: I vantaggi di fare rifornimento sulla luna

entry.content:
I recently published an article on Space Economy on the italian news outlet Airpress. In the article I explore the concept of moon mining for in-orbit refueling. The article delves into the potential advantages of extracting resources from the moon to support space missions, reduce costs, and enhance the sustainability of space exploration. I examine the technological, economic, and environmental aspects of lunar resource utilization and its implications for the future of space travel.

entry.content:
I was invited to hold a presentation to the Crunch Dao Community. The talk entitled Machine Learning Algorthms in Financial Markets focused on explaining how to create an intraday trading strategy using machine learning approaches taken from the most recent academic literature. This session provided community members with actionable insights into applying advanced ML techniques to real-world trading scenarios.

entry.title: Machine Learning in Financial Markets
entry.content:
I was invited to hold a seminar at the AAAI 2024 conference Bridge - AI for Financial Services, on the topic of Machine Learning in Financial Markets. This seminar was held together with Matteo Rampazzo, a colleague from Epsilon SGR. We started with a brief introduction on the uses of algorithms in the financial markets followed by an overview of the tecnical machine learning tools. We then had three main sections, the first on quantitative trading, then quantitative investing and finally on optimal execution.

entry.title: Moon Opportunities
entry.content:
I had the honor of contributing to the “Moon Opportunities” round table at the NSE ExpoForum and present a study on the economic feasibility of Moon mining and in-orbit refuelling, based on a research developed with SDA Bocconi’s Space Economy Evolution Lab. This discussion highlighted the strategic importance of lunar resources for the future of the space economy. A wrap-up of the event can be found at the following link.
